apps.localizedDescription: All-in-one companion for Apple TV: ultra-low-latency Remote (Touchpad + D-Pad), Vietnamese/English keyboard input, instant TV app launcher with Unverified cleanup, curated & custom tvOS App Library (Kodi, Stremio, Orivio TV, Nuvio TV, Yattee, LiveContainerTV, plus direct HTTPS .ipa/.deb auto-conversion & GitHub sources), explicit .p12 / multi-Apple-ID signer selector, smart Clear Cache manager, reliable auto-refresh, verified SHA-256 updates, and wireless sideloading via free Apple ID or paid .p12 certificate.

versions.localizedDescription:
4AppleTV v1.4.2 (Build 51):
• Synchronized 7-day LiveContainerTV expiry display: Fast misagent profile renewals now automatically mirror the Apple-signed .mobileprovision into LiveContainerTV via HouseArrest (even when TV app is closed) and push live updates over :8228 (/api/v1/sync-expiry), fixing the 7-day vs 4-day mismatch.
• Retroactive Auto-Healing: Automatically reconciles already-refreshed LiveContainerTV hosts whenever 4AppleTV connects.
• Keeps ~2-second fast misagent refresh and seamless TV re-pair app recovery.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: 4AppleTV discovers, controls, captures screenshots, launches apps, and installs (.ipa) apps wirelessly on Apple TVs on your local Wi-Fi network.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: 4AppleTV saves copies of captured Apple TV screenshots to your iPhone Photo Library when you choose Save to Photos.
